title: Postdoctoral Fellows in Educational Measurement
institution: University of Oslo, CREATE - Centre for Research on Equality in Education
about: The University of Oslo is recruiting postdoctoral fellows in educational measurement at CREATE (Centre for Research on Equality in Education), Faculty of Educational Sciences. Applications through Jobbnorge (job 309569) close on Friday, 4 December 2026.

upskill.name: the AI for Education Academy
why: Shortlisted courses above the minimum score did not genuinely cover measurement (content creation, ROI); fallback to the closest Academy page.
Field "Educational measurement" → AI for Education Academy, e.g. A010.05 objective "Maintain fairness, reliability, transparency, assessment validity, and meaningful educator oversight"

card_alt: Card for Postdoctoral Fellows in Educational Measurement at the University of Oslo, CREATE - Centre for Research on Equality in Education, Oslo, Norway; deadline 4 Dec 2026. The photo shows the Bryggen wharf houses in Bergen in winter, not Oslo.
